notes.text: - **Executive Board**: **58** members; India re-elected in **November 2021** for **four years** (2021-25).

exam: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
q: The first Woman Director-General of UNESCO is
explanation: Irina Bokova of Bulgaria became the first woman Director-General of UNESCO in 2009.

notes.text: - **First woman Director-General**: **Irina Bokova** (Bulgaria), 2009. Now **Khaled El-Enany** (Egypt) – from **15 Nov 2025**; first Arab DG.

q: As Chairman of an independent commission on education, Jacques Delors report to UNESCO was titled:
options: World Declaration on Education for All
explanation: The Delors Commission's 1996 report to UNESCO was titled 'Learning: The Treasure Within', with its four pillars of learning; 'Education for All' was the 1990 Jomtien declaration.

notes.text: - **Delors Commission** report to UNESCO (1996): "**Learning: The Treasure Within**" (four pillars of learning).

q: The 'Kalinga Prize for the popularization of Science' is awarded by:
explanation: The Kalinga Prize for the Popularization of Science, instituted with a donation from Biju Patnaik (1952), is awarded by UNESCO.

notes.text: - **Kalinga Prize** for the popularisation of science – awarded by **UNESCO** (since 1952).

q: In December 2019, UNESCO added 'Nuad Thai' to its list of "Intangible Cultural Heritage" practices. What is Nuad Thai?
explanation: Nuad Thai, traditional Thai massage, was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in December 2019.

q: Which two Indian cities are among the 66 urban settlements designated as creative cities by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)?
explanation: In 2019 UNESCO named Mumbai (film) and Hyderabad (gastronomy) Creative Cities among 66 new members.

q: Why USA recently decided to withdraw from UNESCO?
options: For not recognizing historic sites in USA
For maintaining relations with North Korea
For recognizing Nazi sites in Germany as historic sites
Against anti Israel bias of the Organization
key_text: Against anti Israel bias of the Organization
explanation: The USA announced its withdrawal from UNESCO (2017, effective 2018; again in July 2025) citing the organisation's anti-Israel bias.

notes.text: - **Members**: **194** Member States + 12 Associate Members (2025-26). **Palestine** became the **195th** member in **October 2011** (South Sudan the 194th, days earlier); the US announced its withdrawal again in July 2025.

q: Which was the first UN organisation to start accepting Cryptocurrency donations?
explanation: UNICEF launched its Cryptocurrency Fund in October 2019 and became the first UN organisation to receive, hold and disburse donations in cryptocurrency (ether, bitcoin); UNESCO, UNDP and UNWTO were not first.

exam: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
q: Which of the following UN organisations has become the first UN organisation to hold and make transactions in Cryptocurrency?
explanation: UNICEF's Cryptocurrency Fund (October 2019) made it the first UN organisation to hold and make transactions in cryptocurrency; UNDP, WHO and FAO did not.

exam: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
q: Which of the following UN agencies works in for the upliftment of well-being of children?
explanation: UNICEF (UN Children's Fund) is the UN body for children's rights and well-being; the WTO and IMF are economic bodies and UNESCO handles education, science and culture.
